# Mock CSS — canonical file structures and shared chrome

The CSS every HTML mock shares: the design-system files and the chrome
strips that make mocks reviewable. Condensed canonical forms — extend as
the project needs, keep the contracts (header comments, class names).

## Contents

- tokens.css structure
- components.css structure
- motion.css structure
- The `.mock-meta` strip
- Flow chrome classes
- The comparison index grid
- File scaffold

---

## tokens.css structure

```css
/*
 * Design tokens for {project}
 * Generated by the ux-ui skill on {date}
 * Direction: {one-line description of the blended direction}
 *
 * Edit by re-running the ux-ui skill's token work (it preserves this header).
 */

:root {
  /* color, type, spacing, radius, elevation — see design-tokens.md */
  --color-bg-primary: #...;
  /* ... */
}

/* Dark mode: pick ONE mechanism */
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { /* dark values */ } }
/* or */
[data-theme="dark"] { /* dark values */ }
```

The header comment is the source of truth for what's locked — future
refinement reads it before proposing changes. Refinement shows before/after,
re-runs the contrast pairings, and never overwrites without explicit user
confirmation.

## components.css structure

```css
/*
 * Component layer for {project} — composed from tokens.css
 * Generated by the ux-ui skill on {date}
 * Aesthetic decisions: {depth / corners / density choices}
 * Common components: {starter set chosen}
 * Project-unique: {list with one-line purpose}
 */

.btn { /* base: padding, radius, font, border, cursor, transition */ }
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-text-inverse); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover); }
.btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
/* ... one block per component, all states */
```

Rules: components style themselves here; mocks never override component
styles inline (layout-only `<style>` blocks in mocks). Every interactive
component ships hover, focus-visible, active, disabled. Hit areas ≥44px.

## motion.css structure

```css
/*
 * Motion language for {project}
 * Generated by the ux-ui skill on {date}
 * Attitude: {primary + secondary}
 * Optional channels: {springs / hold-beat / stepped — included or omitted}
 */

:root {
  --motion-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  /* ... see design-tokens.md */
  --dur-instant: 80ms; --dur-quick: 240ms; --dur-ambient: 600ms;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  :root { --dur-quick: var(--dur-instant); --dur-ambient: var(--dur-instant); }
}
```

## The `.mock-meta` strip

A thin label strip at the top of every option file — names the option,
carries a one-line rationale:

```html
<header class="mock-meta">
  <strong>Option N — {short-label}</strong>
  <span>{one-sentence rationale}</span>
</header>
```

```css
.mock-meta {
  padding: 8px 16px; background: #0d1117; color: #c9d1d9;
  display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: baseline;
  font: 13px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; border-bottom: 1px solid #30363d;
}
.mock-meta strong { font-weight: 600; }
.mock-meta span { color: #8b949e; }
```

Skip it only when the user explicitly asks for clean mocks.

## Flow chrome classes

One sticky header per flow page, class by topology (see `journeys.md`):

| Topology | Class | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| Sequential | `.flow-meta` | Prev/next links + "step N of M" |
| Hub-and-spoke | `.flow-nav` | Persistent nav listing all pages, current marked |
| Hybrid | `.flow-hybrid` | Sequential chrome + cross-jump breadcrumb |
| Map-as-canvas | `.flow-map` | Mode switcher floating over a fill-viewport canvas |
| Chat-as-canvas | `.flow-chat` | Thread column + fixed composer at bottom |

All variants: sticky top, same dark-strip styling language as `.mock-meta`,
current position always visible.

## The comparison index grid

`index.html` — the review artifact. Dark page, N iframes in a grid scaled
to count (2→2x1, 3→3x1, 4→2x2, 5–6→3x2, 7–8→4x2):

```css
body { margin: 0; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; background: #111; color: #eee; }
.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px;
        padding: 8px; height: calc(100vh - 56px); box-sizing: border-box; }
.cell { background: #fff; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;
        display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.cell h2 { margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
           background: #222; color: #eee; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
.cell iframe { border: 0; flex: 1; width: 100%; }
.cell a { color: #6cf; text-decoration: none; }
```

Each cell header: option label + `open ↗` link to the full page. For flows,
the index instead shows step cards visualizing the topology (numbered
sequence / peer grid / sequence with cross-jump arrows).

## File scaffold

Every generated HTML file:

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>{descriptive title}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../design-system/tokens.css">
  <!-- + components.css / motion.css when those layers exist -->
  <style>/* chrome + layout-only page styles */</style>
</head>
<body>
  <header class="mock-meta">...</header>
  <main><!-- component classes, no inline component styling --></main>
  <script>/* small vanilla JS for interactive bits */</script>
</body>
</html>
```
